fields.statement: QA at 903604b3b with the built tools/release binary, real git against a scratch clone and bare origin, a fake gh (CI/release list only) and the real root daemon. record-run against the live daemon appended {commit dbb826dd..., at 2026-11-12T20:16:37Z}; a second run added nothing; with no -runs and RHIZA_RELEASE_RUNS empty it exits 1 with 'no run history file'. cut with every gate passing pushed an annotated v0.2.0 at the candidate commit to origin; a repeat run left origin unchanged; with CI failing it printed the gate and 'v0.2.0 is blocked' and made no tag locally or on origin. systemd-analyze --user verify accepts rhiza-release.timer and .service; agents/vm.md names rhiza-release.timer. FAIL: the annotated tag's message has none of the notes' '## Breaking changes' / '## Milestone ...' headings (git cat-file -p refs/tags/v0.2.0 shows 0 lines starting with #): git tag -a -F strips #-lines under the default cleanup, so the release body that release.yml takes from %(contents:body) loses every section heading.

QA at 903604b3b, built tools/release binary, real git with scratch clone and bare origin, fake gh. With v1.0.0 tagged and a breaking difference since, cut drafted one GitHub release v2.0.0 at the candidate (gh release create --draft --target <candidate>) and pushed no tag; with the draft present a second run created no new draft and pushed nothing. FAIL: after simulating the owner's sign-off (lightweight v2.0.0 at the candidate on origin, gh release list reporting it published) cut's fetch --tags brings the lightweight tag in, git describe --tags then takes v2.0.0 as the last release and cut prints 'none: no release since v2.0.0' and exits 0: the tag on origin stays a lightweight commit tag, so release.yml skips GoReleaser and the signed-off major is never cut.
